<!--
  A consent notice: an icon, a heading, one paragraph and the buttons accept, decline and (optionally) settings.
  Axes: layout (bar, card), actions (two, three), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type CookieBannerProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  accept: string;
  decline: string;
  settings?: string;
  layout?: "bar" | "card";
  actions?: "two" | "three";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  accept,
  decline,
  settings,
  layout = "bar",
  actions = "two",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<CookieBannerProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="section" :aria-labelledby="tpl('{0}-title', id)" data-testid="cookie" :data-layout="layout">
    <Container :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'py-4')" data-slot="container">
      <Box
        :class="cn(
          'flex flex-col gap-4 rounded p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border',
          (((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : 'bg-card'),
          (
            (layout as string) === 'bar' ? 'md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between'
            : 'mx-auto w-full max-w-md'
          )
        )"
      >
        <Group gap="4" align="start" class="min-w-0">
          <LucideIcon name="cookie" :size="24" />
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Title :as="2" size="base" weight="bold" :id="tpl('{0}-title', id)">
              {{ title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
        <Group gap="2" class="shrink-0 flex-wrap">
          <Button
            v-if="(((actions as string) === 'three') && settings)"
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            type="button"
            data-testid="cookie-settings"
          >
            {{ settings }}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="cookie-decline">
            {{ decline }}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="cookie-accept">
            {{ accept }}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
